# Crypto Evidence Daily

> Independent daily crypto reporting for researchers and analysts, explaining protocol changes, market structure and policy through primary sources.

Coverage: Market Structure, Protocol Upgrades, On-chain Activity, Stablecoin Economics, Crypto Policy.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://cryptosnews.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://cryptosnews.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://cryptosnews.github.io/archive/): everything published.
